query:
DELETE FROM eth_txs
            WHERE
                id IN (
                    SELECT
                        UNNEST(ARRAY[eth_commit_tx_id, eth_prove_tx_id, eth_execute_tx_id])
                    FROM
                        l1_batches
                    WHERE
                        number > $1
                    EXCEPT
                    SELECT
                        UNNEST(ARRAY[eth_commit_tx_id, eth_prove_tx_id, eth_execute_tx_id])
                    FROM
                        l1_batches
                    WHERE
                        number <= $1
                )
